UNDERSTAND THE PRODUCT

Product description

Onion seeds are planting seeds for onion crop production. Buyers should specify the variety and required bulb characteristics, together with seed testing and treatment requirements. This is an agricultural planting product, separate from culinary spices.

For planting use. Confirm variety, growing conditions, treatment and destination seed documentation before ordering.

Common applications

Onion crop production; agricultural seed supply.

Specification status

Product form, quality limits, availability and lot test results are agreed with the final offer.

PLANTING ENQUIRIES

How much seed is needed for sowing?

Reference quantities for the stated growing system. Confirm a local recommendation before ordering planting seed.

Sowing quantity — reference guidance
DetailGuidance
Reference seed quantity8–12 kg/hectare of final field area (approximately 3.2–4.9 kg/acre)
Sowing systemSeed used to raise nursery seedlings for transplanting common big / Bellary onion. The rate is based on the final transplanted field area, not the nursery-bed area.
How to apply this referenceThe cited TNAU seedling-production guidance applies to a nursery-and-transplanting system. It is not a universal direct-sowing rate. Variety, day-length adaptation, germination, nursery losses and local planting density affect the final requirement.

Request a current, lot-specific germination and physical-purity report, the test date, variety identity and treatment or coating status. For alfalfa, also confirm the reported hard-seed percentage. Physical purity alone does not establish planting suitability. Seed rate is a cultivation guideline, not a minimum order quantity or a yield guarantee.

Agronomic reference: TNAU — Bellary onion, quality seedling production ↗. Checked 22 October 2026. Acre figures are rounded conversions using 1 hectare ≈ 2.471 acres. These Indian reference rates are not destination-specific recommendations.

PRACTICAL BUYING DETAILS

Before you choose a lot.

Match the product, specification and commercial terms.

Product questions

What variety information should I send?

State the intended growing region, planting season, variety preference and desired bulb colour, shape and market use. Variety suitability and lot availability require confirmation.

Are onion seeds the same as kalonji?

No. This page concerns agricultural onion planting seed. It does not offer kalonji or a culinary black-seed product.
